coaching.headline: Two favored lanes sat out the fights that mattered; we won three fights and converted zero, and lost every Fangtooth.
coaching.team: Willy Guggenheim played Greystone offlane, one of five off a bottom-two lane; the offlane and midlane still read ours all game (Greystone over Bayle, The Fey over Renna), while the carry and jungle read theirs all game (Revenant under Gideon, Khaimera under Zarus). We conceded the first Fangtooth at 17 with nobody dead, a free pickup rather than a lost fight. We never took any of the match's three Fangtooths; the others fell at 23 and 29 -- all three went to them. We won three fights and cashed none of them into a tower or objective; they won six and converted two. Towers finished 2 to 10, and our objective damage finished at 0 against their 42,956. The Fey was alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credit in the 18m game-defining fight. Both Greystone and The Fey were alive and ahead in lane with no credit in the 29.2 Fangtooth loss -- the fight that preceded the Core falling at 30.3.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: At 29.2, Greystone and The Fey were both alive and ahead in their lanes with no kill or death credit in the Fangtooth fight, which we lost 2-3; they took the Fangtooth, and the Core fell at 30.3.
coaching.whatWorked: We outwarded them 42 to 24; Muriel alone placed 18 wards against the enemy support's 5, and we held zero deaths before minute 10 on support.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 won the vision war outright: 18 wards to the enemy support's 5, with zero deaths before minute 10. The one costly moment was getting caught alone by Zarus at 28.3, feeding the Fangtooth that preceded the Core falling at 30.3. Muriel also carried no magic resist into a three-magical-damage enemy comp.

ourKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
ourKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
ourKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

fedBy: Flow State (augment): Evade's Cooldown is 15% lower and its Cooldown resets on Takedown.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,176 hero damage a minute, more than 91% of Zarus jungle players this patch (26% of the team's). The damage came from Berserker's Axe, Augmentation, Judgement.
Coliseum at rank 3: 120s base, about 77.4s by the end (36% shorter) from 55 ability haste: Berserker's Axe 15, Augmentation 20, Basilisk 20.
22 takedowns (15 kills, 7 assists) fed: Flow State (augment).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Zarus dealt 35,275 hero damage, 26% of their team's, with +212 physical power from items.
Berserker's Axe (item): On Dashing or Leaping: Empower your next Basic Attack within 3s. Deal 50 (+40%) Damage. Slows by 55% for 1s.
Augmentation (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal (+90% Base Physical Power) Damage On-Hit.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Alpha's Court (Eternal minor): Deal 6% bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units.

Sustain: 4% omnivamp; Salvation: On going below 30% Health: Gain a (+25%) Shield for 6s. Reduced to 50% Effectiveness for Ranged Heroes. Gain 10% Omnivamp for 6s.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; 16,426 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1575 health, +40 physical armor, +25% tenacity; took 45,901 damage, mitigated 31,905, died 4 times.

Loadout augment Flow State: Evade comes back sooner and resets on every takedown. Dash in for the kill, then Evade again right away to chase the next target or escape. (game text: Evade's Cooldown is 15% lower and its Cooldown resets on Takedown.) (changes Evade, 7.7s cooldown with their haste) Field: 51.5% in 2382 games, 43% of picks, level the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout Eternal Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less back. Strong inside Coliseum, where you fight one target up close. (game text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).) Field: 44.8% in 1103 games, 20% of picks, below the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout minor Alpha's Court: Extra damage when no ally is near you. Fits Zarus dueling one target in Coliseum or a side lane, not grouped fights. (game text: Deal 6% bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units.) Field: 44.9% in 719 games, 65% of picks, below the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout minor Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards long brawls where Gladiator stays maxed. (game text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.) Field: 44.9% in 968 games, 88% of picks, below the hero-role's 51%.

Loadout crest Judgement: Damages everyone around you and heals you for each hero hit. Use it in melee range after Evade or Coliseum lands you on the enemy. (game text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.) Field: 50.2% in 2457 games, 44% of picks, level the hero-role's 51%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Berserker's Axe, Augmentation, Thraex.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Salvation, Judgement.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Zarus killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Greystone, Khaimera, The Fey. We killed Zarus 4 times.

Copy it? Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity): 44.6% in 688 Zarus jungle games, below the hero's 51%; this 3-item core: 54.8% in 372 games, level with the 54% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Coliseum came back about every 77s instead of 120s by the end (36% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
